aesthetic_description: Premium, high-contrast, editorial tattoo-culture aesthetic with obsidian matte backdrops, sharp geometric lines, subtle grainy texture effects, and metallic amber gold accents. Logos and artwork strictly use object-contain to preserve aspect ratio.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight

layout_and_spacing.padding_strategy: Generous spacing philosophy (py-12 to py-24 for marketing, p-6 to p-8 for dashboard cards)
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Fully responsive down to 375px without horizontal overflow. Direct grid children, object-contain on images/logos.

navigation_rules.desktop: Sticky glassmorphism header with z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80 border-b border-zinc-800
navigation_rules.mobile: Sheet/Drawer mobile menu for screen width < 768px with full role-aware links and explicit toggle button
navigation_rules.role_aware_switcher: Workspace dropdown in nav bar allowing seamless switching between 'Independent Artist' mode and associated Studios

tenant_theme_dynamic_override.description: On studio public pages (/t/:slug and /t/:slug/contact), dynamic studio brand colors (--studio-primary and --studio-accent) must override default platform accents.
tenant_theme_dynamic_override.implementation: Apply inline style attribute on page wrapper: style={{ '--studio-primary': tenant.primaryColor, '--studio-accent': tenant.accentColor }} and render custom buttons/badges styled with bg-[var(--studio-primary)] and text-[var(--studio-accent)].
tenant_theme_dynamic_override.logo_rule: Studio and platform logos MUST use object-contain (e.g., class `object-contain max-h-16 max-w-full`) to prevent stretching.

image_prompts: Dark editorial studio photo of a intricate blackwork lotus and geometric sleeve tattoo on moody dark velvet background, dramatic side lighting, high resolution, cinematic 8k
Minimalist fine line tattoo flash art collection displayed on dark textured charcoal leather background, gold ink highlights, editorial luxury magazine style

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, input, tab, card, avatar, menu item, select option, dialog, and key metric text MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

page_blueprints.landing_page: Hero section with high-impact serif typography, floating dark editorial artwork showcase, role selection teasers, feature grid with thin metallic borders, and clear CTA buttons.
page_blueprints.auth_pages: Centered dark luxury glass cards (/login, /signup). Email/password input + 'Continue with Google' mock button + 3-step role picker card for first-time signups.
page_blueprints.client_home: Dashboard layout showing AI design inspiration gallery, saved flash art, and studio search shortcut.
page_blueprints.artist_home: Workspace dashboard with workspace switcher in top nav ('Independent Workspace' vs Studio affiliations), AI design studio quick launch, and active portfolio stats.
page_blueprints.create_studio: Form with real-time slug auto-generation, validation status, and clean step-by-step studio onboarding.
page_blueprints.studio_dashboard_branding: Color picker inputs for primary & accent hex colors, drag-and-drop logo uploader (PNG/JPG/WebP ≤5MB preview), tagline, about text, city (Jakarta / Bali presets), contact email, Instagram.
page_blueprints.studio_dashboard_team: Invite member modal, pending invitations table with revoke actions, active members roster with role badges and remove action.
page_blueprints.invitations_inbox: Clean inbox list with Accept / Decline action triggers and studio branding previews.
page_blueprints.public_studio_page: Custom themed public header & banner using studio brand colors, studio logo (object-contain), tagline, location city badge, artist roster grid, and link to /t/:slug/contact.
page_blueprints.platform_admin: Table listing all tenant studios with name, slug, owner email, active artist count, creation timestamp, and quick view link.

instructions_to_main_agent: All React code must use .js extension (not .tsx).
Ensure all images and studio logos use object-contain object-fit CSS property to prevent image stretching.
Every page header must have a background (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/80) — never use pure transparent header over text.
Strictly attach data-testid to every interactive component, input field, button, and table row.
Use Sonner toast notifications (from src/components/ui/sonner) for actions (studio created, invite sent, branding updated, invite accepted/declined).
Ensure 375px viewport mobile responsiveness with a collapsible Sheet mobile navigation bar.
